summary: An exceptionally clean process: thorough front-loading of spec, tests, data shapes, skill docs and reference designs, followed by a dependency-ordered implementation that passed all 54 tests on its first run and needed zero fix cycles. Verification went beyond the tests — browser screenshots at two viewports compared against the references, and the full suite was re-run after the final edit. The only blemishes are a handful of wasted exploratory calls, an authored-but-never-run typecheck script, and partial visual coverage.
